proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the model badge/logo and the VIN/engine number plate (to confirm exact model).
Tyre sidewall close-ups showing brand/model and DOT date codes (and tread depth).
Video: start-up + slow ride + hard brake test (showing brake response).
Photos of underside/frame, wheel hubs, and fasteners for rust/corrosion check.
Photos of customs/duty clearance documents and any purchase receipt/registration papers.
response.reason: From the single photo, the exact model/identity and the key condition claims (tyres, brakes/gears, rust-free, originality, duty) are not verifiable, so a confident worst-case price cannot be set reliably.
